summary: Today’s feed is mixed but risk-on in parts of crypto, with several analysts leaning bullish on major alts and a few newer narratives, while macro commentary is more cautious on equities and gold. The clearest new opportunities come from altcoin rotation ideas and short-term chart breakouts; equities show selective strength in Apple and Alphabet, while gold is range-bound and Brent is mildly supported.
